# Nguyen Thi Thanh Binh / Nguyễn Thị Thanh Bình

## Profile

Nguyen Thi Thanh Binh, also known as Nguyen Binh and Thanh Bình, is a multidisciplinary practitioner based in Tokyo, Japan. She is a Manager, geoscientist, and subsurface engineer at ENEOS Xplora Inc., working in the e-TEC department. Her work connects geoscience and subsurface engineering with open innovation, artificial intelligence, music, and personal video storytelling.

Her education includes a PhD in Geosystem Engineering from The University of Tokyo. Her undergraduate background is in Geophysics, Faculty of Oil and Gas, Hanoi University of Mining and Geology, Vietnam (ngành Địa vật lý, Khoa Dầu khí, Trường Đại học Mỏ – Địa chất Hà Nội).

## Expertise

- Subsurface engineering and geoscience
- Petroleum geology and geomechanics
- Pore pressure prediction and sediment compaction
- Basin analysis and carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS)
- Open innovation, technology scouting, AI-amplified R&D, and cross-disciplinary exploration
- Vietnamese-Japanese bilingual vocal performance and lyric translation
- Music and video production, editing, and personal storytelling

## Published Geoscience Work

The Geoscience world presents 12 peer-reviewed or conference publications and research on subsurface pressure, sediment compaction, pore pressure, basin stress, and diagenesis. Important subjects include the Sabah, Joetsu, Ursa, Cuu Long, Nam Con Son, and North Sea basins, as well as the Gulf of Mexico and offshore Vietnam.

Selected publications listed on the site include:

- “The role of mobile shale in forming fold belt anticlines and hydrocarbon accumulations in Sabah Basin, Malaysia.”
- “Compaction of smectite-rich mudstone and its influence on pore pressure in the deepwater Joetsu Basin, Sea of Japan.”
- “The role of fluid pressure and diagenetic cements for porosity preservation in Triassic fluvial reservoirs of the Central Graben, North Sea.”
- “History of Pore Pressure Build Up and Slope Instability in Mud-Dominated Sediments of Ursa Basin, Gulf of Mexico Continental Slope.”
- “Stress state in the Cuu Long and Nam Con Son basins, offshore Vietnam.”
- “Present-day stress and pore pressure fields in the Cuu Long and Nam Con Son Basins, offshore Vietnam.”

The site also records field trips and professional affiliations with the Japan Petroleum Technology Association and the Society of Petrophysicists and Well Log Analysts (SPWLA).

## Innovation

The Innovation world documents her approach to turning questions into R&D opportunities: observe, question, explore, challenge, reframe, identify an opportunity, validate, and act. AI is presented as expanding the landscape for search, comparison, and technical due diligence rather than replacing human thinking.

The exhibit presents five innovation posters:

- **Geopressure as energy:** “The Geopressure-to-Value Pathway” explores converting geopressure into operational value; “Five Dimensions of Operational Value” frames the value across multiple dimensions.
- **Self-healing materials:** “The Problem in Hydrogen Embrittlement” examines hydrogen embrittlement as the problem context for self-healing material ideas.
- **Biomass-derived high-value minerals:** “The Next Battery Race” introduces the evolving battery supply landscape, and “A New Supply Chain Is Emerging” focuses on the emergence of new biomass-based supply chains.

## Music and Creative Works

Thanh Bình performs Vietnamese-Japanese bilingual cover songs, provides vocal performances, and translates Japanese lyrics herself.

- **BIỂN HÁT CHIỀU NAY (夕暮れに歌う海)** is the featured MV and her first Vietnamese-Japanese bilingual performance of the song. Filmed locations include Ito, Jogasaki, Kadowaki Cape, Atami, Lý Sơn Island, Thiên Cầm, and Bình Thuận. The story follows the call of the sea from Japan to Vietnam, from morning light through sunset and night.
- **BIỂN HÁT CHIỀU NAY — Karaoke Version** combines Vietnamese-Japanese lyrics with the original MV footage.
- **MONG MANH TÌNH VỀ (儚い愛が戻る)** is a cover performed with Shiawase Band.
- **ĐÔI BỜ** is a cover performed with CLB Shiawase.
- **Original songs:** a new original song is being recorded ahead of copyright registration.

The [Music and MV page](https://nguyenbinh-eneos.vercel.app/music.html) also links the full YouTube channel.

## Video Creation

Thanh Bình personally films and edits class reunion, alumni, travel, and sports videos. The reunion and alumni collections preserve archival university photos and footage that can no longer be filmed today.

- **Class reunion:** “HUMG-Geophysics K31 Oct.2023.”
- **Alumni gatherings:** “HUMG-K31 Student Time,” “Hội khoá K31 Mỏ địa chất theo dòng thời gian,” “Hội khoá K31 Mỏ địa chất thời sinh viên,” and “Hội khoá 31 Mỏ địa chất 2023.”
- **Travel and sports:** “The Trip to Celebrate 2024 Year End & New Year 2025,” “Golden Week Trip P3-5-7 2025,” “2025 Golden Week Trip — When Friends Are Destinations,” and “Chạy Marathon Tiếp Sức.”
